standard_prerequisites.name: Colimit radical computation
standard_prerequisites.relation: radical of an ideal in a filtered colimit

core_obligations: Uniqueness: two opens of the finite level with the same pullback have the same radical in the colimit ring, hence agree after increasing the index (radical equality in colimits).
Existence: any open of the limit lifts to a finite level up to quasi-separatedness; the lifted open's pullback is the given open; coverings of the limit pull back to finite-level coverings.
proof_roadmap: Radical equality in the colimit gives uniqueness after index shift.
Generator lift + gluing gives existence; coverings from uniqueness.
difficulty_reason: Uniqueness via radical equality in a colimit of rings; existence via generator lift plus quasi-separated gluing; coverings follow from uniqueness. Complete two-part argument.

compared.difference: The sibling descends sections of the structure sheaf; this lemma descends the opens themselves (the topology). Different objects over the same limit engine.
